method.population: All retained parseAnnotations records; equal record weights, exact click-count groups. Records are not independent animals or proven distinct biological events.
method.intervals: Full original n-1 positive ICIs in seconds; no clipping, warping, padding, deduplication or count interpolation.
method.durationSeconds: D = sum(d); first to last click, not declared Duration or recording length.
method.gapShares: p_j = d_j / D; dimensionless fractions summing to one.
method.clickPositions: Zero followed by cumulative p; last position one within arithmetic tolerance.
method.intervalCV: sqrt(sum((d_j - mean)^2)/(n-1)) / mean; population interval standard deviation, dimensionless.
method.endpointRatio: last interval / first interval; dimensionless ratio, not monotonic acceleration or rubato.
method.endpointShareDifference: last p - first p; dimensionless fraction, not ornamentation.

quantiles.rule: Sorted values; h=(N-1)q; linear interpolation between floor(h) and ceil(h). Empty=null; singleton=its value; ties unchanged.

sparse.rule: Sparse if either minimum is unmet. UI suppresses bands and percentile judgments; numeric downloads remain descriptive.

method.ranges: Observed 10th–90th percentile range, at each gap position
method.warning: Marginal archive descriptions, not confidence intervals, a joint 80% region or synthesis recipes. Coordinate medians need not sum to one. Never splice or normalize quantiles into an observed exemplar.
method.shape: normalized-interval-mad v1.0.0 from compareTiming; exact count only, ascending distance then source line. Two-click shape is nondiscriminating; ties do not imply identity or meaning.
method.grouping: Exact REC, nine-character prefix and six-character root are provenance labels; caller is local to REC. Roots may be dependent; no resolved animal or encounter identity.
method.selection: Default actual exemplar: ascending source line. Optional ascending duration, CV and endpoint ratio sorts; source-line ties.

annotationSchedule.attenuation: 1 / max(2, maximum overlapping 12 ms pulses); shared click-pulse-1 renderer.
